content.text: No non-solicitation or no-hire obligation is imposed on Customer anywhere in the Agreement; § 12.3 affirmatively confirms this.

input.quote: Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Searches for solicitation, hiring, no-hire, inducement and personnel-restriction language (including §§ 12, 16 and 30) return no covenant restricting Customer from soliciting or employing Vendor personnel. To the contrary, § 12.3 expressly confirms Customer is free to hire any person responding to general recruitment and has made no no-hire commitment, and § 30.1 addresses personnel only as an independent-contractor allocation. This meets the preferred position (no non-solicitation restriction on Customer), so no redline is required.
